name: stress-ng vecwide
description: Start N workers that perform various 8 bit math operations on vectors of 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024 and 2048 bytes. With the -v option the relative compute performance vs the expected compute performance based on total run time is shown for the first vecwide worker. The vecwide stressor exercises various processor vector instruction mixes and how well the compiler can map the vector operations to the target instruction set. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.duration: Duration (seconds) of the benchmarking framework run that produced this score, shared by all benchmarks and configs of that run.
